review:
A kung-fu dojo cluster game with three kinds of Chi Orb wild multipliers. Blue orbs start at 1x and gain +1 every time they join a win. Red orbs gain +1 for every symbol in the winning cluster, so they grow much faster.

The third type, the Balance orb, has its own rule, and all of them stay through cascades – so a long chain lets their values really build. A smart progressive-multiplier design. 10,000x max.
